status: pilot design-validation analysis, not a confirmatory test
delta_convention: delta = S(minuend) - S(subtrahend); expose primary is C1 - C3

provenance.note: The pre-registration names the frozen behavioural code; the runs record the commit that executed. They differ by additive --write-expected-runs plumbing that returns before the first run, so the execution path is identical. Verify with: git diff bc968bb 916434a -- scripts/run_pilot_sweep.py

8000.definition: delta = S_c1_react - S_c3_mas; delta < 0 means c3_mas scored higher

omnibus.test: Kruskal-Wallis H across easy/medium/hard, permutation null

trend.test: Jonckheere-Terpstra, levels ordered easy < medium < hard
trend.preregistered_direction: delta falls with complexity (H1 delta > 0 on easy, H2 delta < 0 on hard)

extreme_contrast.preregistered_direction: positive (delta larger on easy than on hard)

interaction.power_note: A large p does not establish independence from complexity: at ten instances per level this has power only against a large effect.
